description: Calculate all Gibraltar company compliance deadlines for a given year. Returns annual return, accounts filing, tax return (CT1), payments on account, and PAYE deadlines based on incorporation date and accounting reference date.

accountingRefDay.description: Accounting reference date day. Defaults to 31.

accountingRefMonth.description: Accounting reference date month (1-12). Defaults to 12.

incorporationDate.description: Company incorporation date in YYYY-MM-DD format

year.description: Target year for deadlines. Defaults to current year.

name: deadlines
